summary: Iter 153 — Twilio WhatsApp integration end-to-end verified. Backend: 10/10 iter153 pytest cases PASS + 41/41 regression suite (iter145/146/148/151/152) PASS. Frontend: /app/whatsapp page loads correctly after Owner_homeme + 2FA login. All required data-testids present (whatsapp-page, stat-configured, stat-total, stat-sent, stat-failed, sandbox-warning, whatsapp-to, whatsapp-body, whatsapp-send, whatsapp-reload, logs-list). Phone normalization preview live-updates ('01001234567' → 'whatsapp:+201001234567'). Send button correctly disabled when phone is empty/invalid and enabled only when both phone validates AND body is non-empty. Sidebar '💬 WhatsApp' link (href=/app/whatsapp) is rendered under owner section. Sandbox warning banner is visible with all join-sandbox instructions. Delivery logs show 13 prior failed sends as expected (sandbox not joined).
critical_code_review_comments: whatsapp_service.normalize_to_whatsapp handles Egyptian formats robustly: +20/00/local 0XX prefix and strips spaces/dashes/parens; rejects garbage and empty strings — verified across 10 phone variants.

routes/whatsapp.py correctly enforces role gating: send/status/logs require _can_manage roles (app_owner/super_admin/company_admin/admin); send-bulk strictly via require_super_admin; webhook is public but validates X-Twilio-Signature via twilio.request_validator.RequestValidator (fake signature → 403).

Audit-log entry with action='whatsapp.send' is created on EVERY send (success or failure) — verified by querying /api/audit-logs?action=whatsapp.send after a failed sandbox send. whatsapp_logs entry is also persisted with to_normalized, ok=false, error message.
is_whatsapp_configured() reads TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID + TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN at call-time (not at module import) — good for hot env reloads.
WhatsAppPage.js correctly disables send button when previewNormalized.valid is false OR body is empty OR sending is in progress (line 199) — UX prevents bad sends client-side.
Phone normalization preview is debounced 250ms via setTimeout/clearTimeout — avoids hammering /api/whatsapp/normalize-test on every keystroke.

Minor: One console 403 was observed on /app/whatsapp page load but does NOT originate from any WhatsApp endpoint — all 4 whatsapp endpoints (status/logs/normalize-test) returned 200 and the page rendered fully. Likely an unrelated background widget on the layout; non-blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 9 required testids present, send button gating correct, sidebar link present)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter153 WhatsApp integration is fully verified and stable. Twilio Sandbox isn't joined (user manual step) so actual deliveries return Twilio Error 63007 'Channel not found' — this is expected behavior. The backend still creates whatsapp_logs (ok=false) + audit_logs (success=false) entries for every attempt, which is the correct compliance behavior. Owner_homeme TOTP seed is intact. /app/whatsapp route uses data-testids: whatsapp-page, stat-configured, stat-total, stat-sent, stat-failed, sandbox-warning, whatsapp-to, whatsapp-body, whatsapp-send, whatsapp-reload, logs-list, whatsapp-log-{id}. Owner login flow: /api/auth/login → two_factor_required=true → /api/2fa/verify-login with TOTP → access_token; UI lands on /select-account, then user must navigate manually to /app/whatsapp.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in iter153. The 'WhatsApp message did not actually send' observation is EXPECTED — Twilio Sandbox requires the user to first send 'join <code>' from their WhatsApp app to +14155238886. The UI explicitly displays a sandbox-warning banner with instructions. Backend tests and code validate that the full request-handling/logging/audit pipeline works correctly regardless of Twilio's delivery outcome.
